notes.title: Input Fixes, Performance Boost & New Features
notes.content:
This update brings important fixes and new features:

ADDED:

 Steam Achievements (BBQed, How Did I Get Here, Bigger Sword, Locked and Loaded, Dragon Slayer, Still Counts as One, Death is only the beginning)
 Option to invert mouse input X+ Y Axis
 
IMPROVED:

 Performance optimizations (reduced CPU draw calls to GPU)

FIXED: 

 Input processors auto-resetting after remapping an Inputbinding

We are working hard to find the bottleneck that causes lags in the town area.
Thanks for playing and supporting the game! More updates coming soon 💛

notes.title: Hotfixes "Day One"
notes.content:
FIXED: Player Katana - Ultimate not costing any ressources
FIXED: Ballista shootable without the collectible
FIXED: Player Camera jitter on lower framerates
FIXED: Player Camera 180-Flip when locking on target and either far or close to the target
FIXED: Player not occupying closest cell on the entity-grid when standing far from the closest one (more than 3x3 cells away)
